# Run book: Ask a question about your own text

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/ask-your-own-documents.md) | [Spec](../specs/ask-your-own-documents.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)

- [Verify](#verify)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Purpose

Ground answers in your own text (retrieval augmented generation) so the model answers from your passages instead of guessing.

## Preconditions

- The Ollama container is running with the phi3 model.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Ask a question about your own text"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/ai/rag`:

1. **Review the passages and the question.** Sample passages are filled in. Separate your own passages with a blank line. Expect: The Ask button is enabled.
2. **Ask.** The API finds the closest passages by cosine similarity and asks the model to answer from them only. Expect: An answer is shown. The sources table lists the passages used, closest first.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Answer ignores the passages | Too few passages are selected | Raise Passages to use |
| Request times out | The model is cold or CPU only | Retry; the first call loads the model |

Related framework features: OoBDev.Onnx.SentenceEmbeddings; OoBDev.Ollama; OoBDev.AI.Abstractions.
